title: Suggest Triage Reference
desc: T3 Reference: guard chain workarounds, known bugs, proven patterns for suggest-triage-playbook
steps: MERGE CROSS-CWD BUG: suggest merge --all-matching fails code=1 for sibling CWD. WORKAROUND: pairwise form suggest merge TS_A TS_B --title --root-cause --components --affected-cmds --work (all 5 flags required). Loop oldest-pair merges until 1 remains.
ESCAPE-HATCH: cleared skill-pending lock immediately before delegating with no intervening file write. Sequence: file edit -> skill edit (clears lock) -> delegate with no file write between.

wkcodex KILL-GUARD: blocks tasks whose text contains kill-words near wkappbot even when not actually killing. Strip all word-boundary kill tokens from Codex briefs; describe FOCUS-STEAL cluster without -kill suffix.

RESOLVE CMD-GUARD: evidence script must source-contain records affectedCommands (e.g. ask gpt ask claude ask gemini verbatim for ASK clusters). Put all variants in script echo and comment. BUG-AUTO merge records carry multiword affectedCommands.

REQUIREMENT-FILL FOR MERGED RECORDS: MERGEx2 survivors carry 0 requirements, resolve demands >=3. FIRST add 3 cheap requirements via suggest add-requirement TS cmd=>expected. THEN resolve with evidence script. This is the merge-drops-requirements gap.

CMD-GUARD MULTIWORD: resolve CMD-guard substring-matches FULL affectedCommand against script. BUG-AUTO ASK CDP carry MULTIWORD like ask gpt ask claude ask gemini. Evidence script must contain exact phrases verbatim.
